verses.1: My soul has left me in this world. My friends have abandoned me. They speak to my soul in silence.
verses.2: He said to the Lord, “Do not abandon me; inform me about what I should do.”
verses.3: It is better for you to be obedient, so that you won’t be deceived. It will come upon you, and it will happen because of the advice of the wicked.
verses.4: The eyes of birds are for you; if you were to see human beings, you would see nothing.
verses.5: The days of man will be like those of old men, if we change our ways.
verses.6: For if you try to tempt me and cause me to sin, I will resist.
verses.7: In your opinion, I am not evil, and no one can protect me from it.
verses.8: Your hands weighed me down, and they made me sink together around me. They swallowed me up.
verses.9: Remember, O Lord, that You created me from coal. And to the fire I will be returned.
verses.10: Do not use milk to nourish me, nor do you bind me with weights.
verses.11: May thorns and brambles cover me, and may hooks and nails be used to bind me.
verses.12: You have done what is good and merciful towards me. Your kindness has protected my soul.
verses.13: And these things, which you see in your heart, I know are indeed with you.
verses.14: If I have sinned, and you still keep me safe from punishment, then I will not be cleansed.
verses.15: If I am evil, then cry out for help; but if I am righteous, then do not lift my head high. Look at my poverty and suffering.
verses.16: And I will be angry when my limbs are injured, and I will be devastated.
verses.17: You shall renew your strength against me, and increase your power. I will be with you, along with my army.
verses.18: And why, from where you were taken away, do you not look at me?
verses.19: Since I wasn’t born from a mother’s womb, I couldn’t be born from it either.
verses.20: It isn’t long before it will end. It stops from me, but it still causes pain.
verses.21: Before I go away, and before I return to that dark and gloomy land.
verses.22: The land was in a state of chaos, like a dark and disordered place. It was in a state of disarray, just like a dark and chaotic place.
